metric.description: Display a single KPI value with optional delta comparison using st.metric()

parameters.label: The header or title for the metric
parameters.value: Value of the metric (int, float, or string)
parameters.delta: Indicator of change (shows with up/down arrow)
parameters.help: Tooltip displayed next to the metric label

config.label: Total Revenue
config.help: Total revenue for the selected period

markdown.description: Display formatted text, insights, or summaries using st.markdown()

config.content:
### Key Insights
- Product A is the best seller
- Sales increased by 15% this month

dataframe.description: Display tabular data with sorting and filtering using st.dataframe()

parameters.title: Optional title displayed above the dataframe
parameters.data: List of dictionaries or dictionary of lists
parameters.hide_index: Whether to hide the index column (default: true)
parameters.use_container_width: Whether to use full container width (default: true)

dataframe.data_format: List of dictionaries (each dict is a row) or dictionary of lists (each key is a column)

bar_chart.description: Display bar chart using st.bar_chart() for comparing categories or values

parameters.title: Optional title displayed above the chart
parameters.data: List of dictionaries with consistent keys for chart data
parameters.x: Column name for x-axis (optional, uses index if not specified)
parameters.y: Column name(s) for y-axis (string or list of strings)
parameters.color: Column name for categorical coloring, or color string/hex code
parameters.horizontal: Display horizontal bars instead of vertical (default: false)
parameters.stack: Whether to stack bars (default: true for multiple series)

bar_chart.data_format: List of dictionaries where each dictionary represents a data point

line_chart.description: Display line chart using st.line_chart() for showing trends over time

parameters.title: Optional title displayed above the chart
parameters.data: List of dictionaries with consistent keys for chart data
parameters.x: Column name for x-axis (optional, uses index if not specified)
parameters.y: Column name(s) for y-axis (string or list of strings)
parameters.color: Column name for categorical coloring, or color string/hex code

line_chart.data_format: List of dictionaries where each dictionary represents a data point

area_chart.description: Display area chart using st.area_chart() for showing cumulative trends or stacked data

parameters.title: Optional title displayed above the chart
parameters.data: List of dictionaries with consistent keys for chart data
parameters.x: Column name for x-axis (optional, uses index if not specified)
parameters.y: Column name(s) for y-axis (string or list of strings)
parameters.color: Column name for categorical coloring, or color string/hex code
parameters.stack: How to stack areas: true, false, 'normalize', or 'center'

area_chart.data_format: List of dictionaries where each dictionary represents a data point

scatter_chart.description: Display scatter chart using st.scatter_chart() for showing relationships between variables

parameters.title: Optional title displayed above the chart
parameters.data: List of dictionaries with consistent keys for chart data
parameters.color: Column name for categorical coloring, or color string/hex code
parameters.size: Column name for variable sizing, or constant size value

scatter_chart.data_format: List of dictionaries where each dictionary represents a data point
